scope: Linked LoRA preview source lookup and official Civitai API
confirmed_observations: Nine imported files, local sidecars and upstream declarations have matching complete SHA256 values and source identities.
Nine official version endpoints return HTTP 200 with matching version, model and registered file identities, and 62 image candidates in total.
The GYARI official version and hash queries resolve the same registered file; the configured mirror fails to connect for both queries.
The bulk preview path previously fell back to hash lookup despite having a linked version ID; the provider fallback can turn non-rate-limit failures into Model not found.
changes: Use the official Civitai API and preserve existing downloader authentication, rate-limit and offline handling.
Query a linked version directly, require matching version and model IDs, and match the remote file against a complete local SHA when available.
Use only remote image candidates; preserve local names, trigger words, notes, favourites and other personal fields.
Keep hash lookup for records without a version ID and keep explicit version lookup failures without another hash retry.
Do not permanently cache version responses without usable preview URLs; keep the existing bounded LRU for responses with images.
rollback: Restore only these two source files and the matching service; never replace current databases with old backups.
